mechanics.claim: Needlework can be recast up to two more times within 8 seconds of activation at no additional cost, each recast refreshing the duration and increasing needle count by 2.
mechanics.quote: ''Needlework'' can be recast twice more within 8 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. Each subsequent cast refreshes the duration and increases the number of needles launched by 2.

mechanics.claim: Only the first cast (single needle) applies the Initial Slow; needle hits beyond the first on later casts apply the weaker Subsequent Slow to each target hit.
mechanics.quote: Needle hits beyond the first apply a {{tip|slow}} against each individual target.

mechanics.claim: Gwen can move during Needlework's cast times.
mechanics.quote: '''Gwen''' can move during Needlework's cast times.

mechanics.claim: Dying during a cast prevents the remaining needles of that cast from firing.
mechanics.quote: Dying during the cast time will prevent the remaining needles of the cast from being launched.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks only one needle, so subsequent needles in the same cast or later casts still land.
